verdict.rationale: Llama ships an official GitHub CLI/toolkit (`llama-models`) for downloading, verifying and inspecting models, plus Hugging Face integration and agent-oriented features like function calling (llama-gh-1, llama-gh-3, llama-docs-2), which give AI-native developers some official tooling to build against. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated language SDK (e.g., Python/JS client library) for invoking Llama as an API, and the developer docs (overview/get-started) are gated behind an SSO login wall rather than openly readable, undermining a smooth 'build against official SDK' experience. missing for 10: a first-party API SDK beyond model-download CLI, open (non-gated) developer docs, independent hands-on confirmation of building agentic apps with it.
